description: Architecture Decision Record (ADR) Index for Unified Engineering Agents System

adrs.title: Unify on EAS v2 Core with AgentFactory UI/LLM Gateway
adrs.decision: Consolidate on EAS v2 core (grants, sandbox, evidence, honest states) as the execution substrate. AgentFactory provides UI (Dashboard), WebSocket EventBus, and LLM gateway (UnifiedLLMClient). Zero shared code between the two original systems.
adrs.context: Two independent systems existed: AgentFactory (8 agents, mock LLM, WebSocket dashboard) and EAS v2 (5 roles, real LLM, Linux sandbox, grants). Both had 13-state machines but different semantics. Unification required choosing one core.
alternatives: Merge both agent sets into single orchestrator
Keep both systems separate with API bridge

positive: Single source of truth for state machine, grants, sandbox
LLM provider adapters unified (6 real providers, no mock)
negative: Windows partial isolation only (Job Objects vs Linux namespaces)
AgentFactory agents need rewrite to EAS v2 role protocol
Migration effort for existing AgentFactory users

adrs.title: No Mock Providers in Production Paths
adrs.decision: Remove MockLLMProvider entirely. All LLM interactions use real providers (NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, Custom). Tests skip gracefully when no provider configured.
adrs.context: AgentFactory used MockLLMProvider for testing and demos. This created false confidence - tests passed but production failed. User explicitly requested: 'لا اريد ان ارى كلمة mock بالمشروع'.
alternatives: Keep mock for unit tests only
Mock at HTTP layer for integration tests
Use Ollama local as test provider

positive: No production path depends on mock behavior
Tests reflect real provider behavior (rate limits, errors, streaming)
Forces proper API key management in CI/CD
negative: CI requires API keys or Ollama running

adrs.title: State Machine: 13 States + 2 Sub-Verdicts (Not 15 States)
adrs.decision: Keep 13 honest states for mission lifecycle. NOT_EVIDENCED and STAGNANT are sub-verdicts that drive transitions, not states themselves. This matches EAS v2 design.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had 13 states. EAS v2 had 13 states + NOT_EVIDENCED/STAGNANT as sub-verdicts. Some wanted 15 states. Decision: sub-verdicts are flow control signals, not persistable states.

positive: Clear separation: states = persistence, sub-verdicts = flow control
Audit trail shows state transitions, not sub-verdict transitions
negative: Must check sub_verdict field on Verification/Arbiter records
UI must display sub-verdict separately from state

adrs.title: Golden Rule: VERIFIED Only by actor='user'
adrs.decision: VERIFIED state transition is ONLY allowed when actor='user'. No agent, verifier, arbiter, or system component can grant VERIFIED. Enforced in validate_transition().
adrs.context: EAS v2 Order 004: 'VERIFIED only by user'. AgentFactory had no such rule - missions could auto-complete. This is the critical safety gate.
alternatives: Verifier can grant VERIFIED with high confidence
Arbiter can grant VERIFIED after max retries

negative: Requires human availability for every mission
Cannot run fully autonomous batch missions
Dashboard/CLI must be accessible for approval

adrs.title: Order 004: STOPPING → STOPPED Only (Safe Stop Request)
adrs.decision: STOPPING can only transition to STOPPED. STOPPING request only by user or orchestrator. Enables checkpoint-based resume.
adrs.context: EAS v2 Order 004: 'STOPPING→STOPPED for safe stop request'. AgentFactory had no stop/resume. This is critical for long missions.

positive: No partial work lost on stop

adrs.title: Grants: HMAC-Signed, Typed, Expiring, Revocable
adrs.decision: Adopt EAS v2 grant model exactly: typed (read/write/execute/admin), scoped to domains/resources, HMAC-SHA256 signed, expiring, revocable. Validated at admission AND execution.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had no grant system. EAS v2 had full capability-based authorization. No alternative - grants are fundamental to sandbox security.

positive: Dual validation (admission + execution) = defense in depth
negative: Performance overhead on every sandbox call

adrs.title: Sandbox: No Host Execution Fallback (Fail-Closed)
adrs.decision: If sandbox unavailable (Linux substrate missing on Windows, image pull failed, limits exceeded), operation FAILS. No fallback to host execution. This is EAS v2 D-04=A.
adrs.context: AgentFactory ran tools on host. EAS v2 requires sandbox. WindowsExecutor provides partial isolation via Job Objects but cannot match Linux namespaces/seccomp.
alternatives: Partial sandbox on Windows, full on Linux

positive: Consistent security model - no escape hatch
Forces proper sandbox setup in deployment
Clear failure mode: 'sandbox unavailable' not 'running on host'
negative: CI must provide Linux runners for full tests

adrs.title: NetworkMode.NONE Always for Sandbox
adrs.decision: Sandbox network mode is ALWAYS NONE. No outbound network from sandbox. Web access via tools (web_search, web_fetch) runs on host with grants.
adrs.context: EAS v2 D-04=A: NetworkMode.NONE. AgentFactory had no network isolation. This prevents data exfiltration and supply chain attacks.

positive: No surprise network calls from sandbox
Web access audited via tool calls
negative: Cannot run npm install, pip install in sandbox
Must vendor dependencies or use pre-built images
Build commands need network = pre-baked images

adrs.title: Evidence: Content-Addressable (SHA256), Immutable Records
adrs.decision: All evidence is content-addressable via SHA256. EvidenceRecord is immutable once created. Verification checks hash match, not filesystem paths.
adrs.context: EAS v2 uses content-addressable evidence. AgentFactory had no evidence model. This prevents tampering and enables reproducible verification.

positive: No TOCTOU attacks on filesystem paths
negative: Must compute hash for every artifact

adrs.title: Review Cycles: Max 3 Then Arbiter
adrs.decision: Maximum 3 review cycles (REVISE → PLANNING). On 4th, Arbiter automatically invoked. State machine enforces this.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had unlimited review cycles. EAS v2 enforces max 3. This prevents infinite loops where reviewer keeps requesting changes.

negative: May escalate prematurely for complex reviews
Reviewer must be decisive within 3 rounds

adrs.title: Arbiter Max 3 Calls Then Forced Escalation
adrs.decision: Arbiter can be called maximum 3 times per mission. On 4th conflict, forced ESCALATED_TO_HUMAN. Sub-verdict STAGNANT tracks repeated same-fingerprint conflicts.
adrs.context: EAS v2 Arbiter has retry budget. AgentFactory had no Arbiter. This prevents infinite Arbiter retries.

adrs.title: Universal LLM Gateway: 6 Providers, Structured Output
adrs.decision: UnifiedLLMClient supports 6 providers (NVIDIA, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, Custom OpenAI-compatible). All support structured_chat() with JSON schema injection. Provider auto-detection priority: NVIDIA > OpenAI > Anthropic > Google > Ollama.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had MockLLMProvider only. EAS v2 had NVIDIA + OpenAI. Need unified gateway for all providers with structured output for agent contracts.

adrs.title: Checkpoint Resume: Full State Recovery
adrs.decision: Checkpoints capture: mission state, task states, artifact IDs, evidence hashes. Resume creates new run with parent_run_id. Full state recovery from checkpoint.
adrs.context: EAS v2 had checkpoint/resume. AgentFactory had none. Order 004 requires STOPPING→STOPPED for safe stop with checkpoint.

adrs.title: Event Bus: In-Process Pub/Sub with WebSocket Bridge
adrs.decision: EventBus is in-process pub/sub for FactoryEvent (Pydantic). WebSocket server on ws://127.0.0.1:8768 bridges to Dashboard. EventStore persists for replay.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had WebSocket EventBus. EAS v2 had no event system. Unified system uses AgentFactory's event model with EAS v2 event types.

negative: Event loss on process crash (mitigated by EventStore)

adrs.title: Dashboard: Production Mode Only, Provider Dropdown
adrs.decision: Dashboard settings modal shows only 'Production' mode. Provider dropdown with 6 options (nvidia, openai, anthropic, google, ollama, custom). Settings persist to stored_settings.json.
adrs.context: AgentFactory had 'mock' and 'production' modes. Removed mock mode per ADR-002. Provider selection required for production.

negative: Must configure API key before use
